notes.title: Electromaze Version 1.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Electromaze Version 1.1[/h1]

[h2]What's new?[/h2][list][*] Increased resources gained on normal difficulty. This should make the game easier to get used to.
[*] Visual tweaks: New waypoints and other small improvements will make the game look better! We also added 2 new color schemes for when you want to give the game a makeover.
[*] Balance changes: Advanced towers were slightly adjusted to be more balanced overall. If you had a strategy figured out before, try out various advanced towers again to see if you can find something new!
[*] Fixed several issues with saving and loading. There should be no more issues leaving and coming back to a game.
[*] Fixed a bug with Steam Achievements. They should now be properly awarded in every scenario.
[/list]

[h2]Now Available on Google Play Store![/h2]
Want to play Electromaze Defense on the go? Give the Android version a try! [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.BaronnerieGames.ElectromazeDefense]Download it here.[/url]

notes.notes:
